headline: Findlay alone unbeaten while every rival has lost
dek: Findlay have won all three of their matches and conceded only twice. Kentucky Wesleyan scored their first goals of the season to win at Union, which leaves Cedarville as the only programme in the conference still without a goal.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Findlay's six goals have come from five different scorers, and only two have gone in at the other end.

wire.line: Kentucky Wesleyan have scored at last, winning at Union, and Cedarville are now the only side without a goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have gone past their date with no published result. Kentucky Wesleyan account for most of them, and Walsh's visit to Pitt-Johnstown is the other.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Kentucky Wesleyan's win at Union is the season's one box score gap: the site holds the score and no detail of how it came about.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cedarville have drawn once and lost three times, conceding six goals and scoring none, after Saturday's defeat at Maryville.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Malone's win over California (PA) on Saturday was their first of the season, after losing their opener to Salem.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nick Cherry has two shutouts for Tiffin, and Saturday's goalless draw with Davenport was the second of them.

last_match.line: Tiffin have drawn their last two and have not lost since their opening night against Charleston.

next_match.line: Thomas More have lost their last two since an emphatic opening win, and this is their final outing before conference play begins at Malone.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
